Mike, saw Nextech launched Cora Scribe and took Best in KLAS for ophthalmology two years running.

When the product wins stack up like that, there are usually more in-market practices than the team can reach before the buying window closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Mike, quick follow-up for Nextech.

With new AI products and RCM expansion, pipeline targets tend to outrun headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nextech needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Mike, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
